description: Check whether the configured macOS Keychain backend is available and readable by the current user. Returns only bounded boolean proof fields and never exposes credentials.
embedding_description: Vault qualification: test Keychain availability and current-user readability without returning credential names or values.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Bounded Keychain proof: backend, available, and current_user_accessible.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Use a false result to diagnose local Keychain setup before vault-dependent work.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Checks the configured Keychain backend without reading or returning credentials.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: A false proof field indicates the configured backend is unavailable or inaccessible to the current user.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Verify the macOS Keychain backend and current-user permissions, then retry.
